displayDescription: A signal lamp match-cuts to a train headlight, then one fixed view compresses 18:00 to 23:00 as a city block lights up connected.
motionEngine: GSAP 3.15.1 (local gsap.min.js, single paused timeline window.__timelines.video)
audioDescription: Silent preview; no music, effects or narration.
limitations: Illustrative procedural vector city, not footage of a real place; periodic intervals (90 s, 4 min) and the 18:00–23:00 span are labelled illustrations, compressed to under 1 s each.
Lighting is approximated with flat vector fills, radial glow gradients and an opacity crossfade from a dusk to a night gradient; no physical light simulation.
No reviewed preview recipes were provided (STYLE.json has no tech.preview_recipes), so the preview demonstrates the catalogue's core characteristic action.
No BACKGROUND_REVIEW.json was supplied; scene palette is taken from the ILLUSTRATION reference (night navy, amber, teal, cream) per scene_dependent background policy.

Blender not used. GSAP is loaded from the host-provided local gsap.min.js; the dependency-finalisation tool failed because the project's dependency record file is missing, so no technology record was written.
